description: On the table there’s a gray tub holding ice cubes, a yellow cup to the left, and a purple scoop on the right. The left hand reaches in to steady and slightly tilt the gray tub while the right hand picks up the purple scoop, digs into the ice, lifts it out, then moves over the yellow cup as the left hand brings the cup up; the right hand tips the scoop to dump the ice into the cup and then pulls the scoop away.
